name: Zombicide
description: Zombicide is a game where you and your friends work together to stay alive in a city full of zombies. You find weapons, fight the zombies, and your heroes get stronger. You win or lose as a team.

name: Zombicide: Black Plague
description: Zombicide: Black Plague is like Zombicide, but in a land of castles from long ago. Your heroes fight zombies with swords, bows and magic. You work as a team, and your heroes get stronger.

name: Dead of Winter: A Crossroads Game
description: In Dead of Winter, a small group of people tries to live through a cold winter after zombies took over the world. You must find food and fuel. One player may be a traitor who wants the group to fail.

name: Last Night on Earth: The Zombie Game
description: In Last Night on Earth, zombies attack a small town at night. One side plays the town people who try to stay alive. The other side plays the zombies. It feels like an old horror movie.

name: Mall of Horror
description: In Mall of Horror, zombies are outside a shopping mall and you are inside with other people. When the zombies come in, the group votes who is thrown to them. You cannot trust anyone.

name: Escape: Zombie City
description: In Escape: Zombie City, zombies fill the city and your team must run to a safe place before time is over. Everyone plays at the same time. The game is fast and a bit crazy.

name: This War of Mine: The Board Game
description: This War of Mine tells the story of normal people in a city during a war. They hide at home in the day and go out at night to find food. Every choice has a price.

name: Nemesis
description: In Nemesis, a ship crew wakes up in space and finds out that aliens are on the ship. Everyone wants to get home alive, but each player has a secret goal. The game is scary and tense.

name: Pandemic Legacy: Season 1
description: Pandemic Legacy is a campaign game played over many evenings. Stickers go on the board, cards are torn up and sealed boxes are opened. Doctors and scientists fly around the world map and treat diseases.

name: Arkham Horror: The Card Game
description: In Arkham Horror: The Card Game, you play a detective in a spooky town. You use cards to look for clues and to fight scary monsters. Every story is a mystery that you play with your friends.

name: Wingspan
description: Wingspan is a calm game about birds. You bring birds to your own nature park, and each bird helps you in a special way. The game is quiet and the cards are beautiful.

name: Everdell
description: In Everdell, you lead a small group of forest animals. You build a little town with homes and shops in the trees, and you get ready for winter. The art is lovely and the game is friendly.

name: Root
description: In Root, cute animals fight to control a forest. Each side plays in a very different way and has a different goal. The game looks sweet, but it is really a game about war.

name: Ticket to Ride Legacy: Legends of the West
description: Ticket to Ride Legacy is a train game in the Old West. You build train lines across the country. The map changes and grows as you play many games with the same friends.

name: Heat: Pedal to the Metal
description: Heat is a car racing game. You drive fast around the track, but if you go too fast your engine gets too hot. You play cards to go faster or slower at the right time.

name: The Crew: Mission Deep Sea
description: The Crew is a card game where all players are one team. In each mission your team must win certain cards, but you may not talk about your cards. The missions go to the bottom of the sea.

name: Sky Team
description: Sky Team is a game for two players. You are two pilots who must land a plane together. You cannot say everything you plan, so you must trust each other.

name: Crokinole
description: Crokinole is played on a round wooden board. You flick small discs to hit the discs of your opponent and to land in the middle. It is easy to learn and fun to watch.

name: 7 Wonders Duel
description: 7 Wonders Duel is a game for two players. You build cities and great buildings of the old world, like the pyramids. You can win by war, by science or by points.

name: Terraforming Mars
description: Terraforming Mars is a game about changing the red planet. Each player leads a big company. You make oceans, plant forests and give Mars air to breathe. The most points wins.

name: Lost Ruins of Arnak
description: In Lost Ruins of Arnak, you explore a lost island. You look for old temples and treasure, and you meet strange animals. You use your cards and your helpers to find new things.

name: Great Western Trail
description: In Great Western Trail, you are a cowboy who takes cows across America to sell them in a big city. You buy good cows, build houses on the way and earn money.

name: Scythe
description: Scythe takes place in a farming land with giant walking robots. Each player leads a group that wants to grow and become the strongest. You can fight, but many players try not to.

name: Spirit Island
description: In Spirit Island, you play spirits of nature. People from far away come to your island, and your team must stop them. Each spirit has its own special powers.

name: Slay the Spire: The Board Game
description: Slay the Spire is a card game for friends. You climb a tower, fight monsters and make your cards stronger. It comes from a popular video game.

name: Marvel Champions: The Card Game
description: In Marvel Champions, you play a superhero like Spider-Man or Iron Man. You use cards to fight a bad guy and stop his plans. You can play alone or with friends.

name: Star Wars: Rebellion
description: Star Wars: Rebellion is a game about the big war in space. One player leads the Empire and the other leads the Rebels. The Empire wants to find the secret base of the Rebels.

name: War of the Ring: Second Edition
description: War of the Ring is a game about the story of The Lord of the Rings. One player leads the good heroes and the other leads the dark lord. The war goes across all of Middle-earth.

name: The Lord of the Rings: Duel for Middle-earth
description: The Lord of the Rings: Duel for Middle-earth is a game for two players. One plays the heroes with the ring and the other plays the dark side. There are a few ways to win.

name: Gloomhaven
description: Gloomhaven is a big fantasy adventure. You and your friends play heroes who go into dark caves and fight monsters. You play many games, and your heroes get stronger.

name: Gloomhaven: Jaws of the Lion
description: Jaws of the Lion is an easier start to Gloomhaven. You play fantasy heroes who go into dark places and fight monsters. It teaches the rules slowly, step by step.

name: Frosthaven
description: Frosthaven is a big fantasy adventure in a cold land. You and your friends build a town and go out to fight monsters in the snow. It is a long game with many steps.

name: Clank!: Catacombs
description: In Clank!: Catacombs, you are a thief in a dark dungeon. You take treasure and try to get out, but every noise can wake up a dragon. It is a game of taking risks.

name: Too Many Bones
description: In Too Many Bones, you play small heroes who fight monsters on adventures. You roll many dice, and your heroes learn new skills. You can play alone or with friends.

name: Viticulture Essential Edition
description: In Viticulture, you own a small wine farm in Italy. You plant grapes, make wine and sell it. The player with the best wine business wins.

name: Dune: Imperium
description: Dune: Imperium is a game about the desert planet from the Dune stories. You send people to get spice and to make friends with big families. You use cards to get more power.

name: Ark Nova
description: In Ark Nova, you build a modern zoo. You get animals, make homes for them and help to save animals in the wild. The best zoo wins.

name: Frostpunk: The Board Game
description: In Frostpunk, the world is frozen and you lead the last city on Earth. You must keep your people warm and fed, and every choice has a cost. The players work together to keep the city alive.

name: Metro 2033
description: In Metro 2033, a nuclear war has destroyed the city above. Survivors hide in the tunnels below and fight for the stations. You send out your hero and your army to win.

name: Aftermath
description: In Aftermath, the humans are gone and you lead a small colony in the ruined world they left behind. You look for supplies, explore the land and fight to protect your home.

name: Zona: The Secret of Chernobyl
description: A scavenger in the land of Chernobyl, you look for rare things and try to stay away from mutants. Zona is a short, tense adventure for friends.

name: Tamashii: Chronicle of Ascend
description: Tamashii is set in a ruined future where machines rule the planet. Players move their minds into new bodies, explore a broken city and fight machines. They also fight in a computer world.

name: Resident Evil 2: The Board Game
description: In Resident Evil 2, your team tries to escape a city full of zombies and monsters. You choose your heroes, count your bullets and work together. The game comes from a famous video game.

name: Resident Evil 3: The Board Game
description: In Resident Evil 3, heroes try to escape a city in the middle of a zombie outbreak. A big monster hunts you, so you must use your supplies with care. The game comes from a famous video game.

name: Twilight Struggle
description: Twilight Struggle is a game for two players about the Cold War. One player is the United States and the other is the Soviet Union. You try to win friends around the world.

name: Formula D
description: Formula D is a car racing game on real race tracks. You pick a gear, roll a special die and drive your car around the corners. If you go too fast in a corner, your car gets damaged.

name: Downforce
description: Downforce is a car racing game where you bet on cars. All players use cards to make the cars go faster around the track. If your cars finish first, you win money.

name: Rallyman: GT
description: Rallyman: GT is a fast car racing game. You roll dice for each gear and drive your car around a track that you build yourself. Roll more dice to go faster, but take care not to crash.

name: Rallyman: DIRT
description: Rallyman: DIRT is about driving a rally car on mud, snow and gravel. You roll dice to drive fast and try to get the best time on the road. If you push your luck too far, your car slides off the road.

name: Speed Circuit
description: Speed Circuit is a racing game with open-wheel race cars, like in Formula 1. Before the race you spend points on speed, tires and brakes. If you drive too fast in a corner, you lose tires or crash.

name: Thunder Alley
description: Thunder Alley is a stock car racing game. You run a team of cars and play cards to move them around the track. The cars drive in a group, and you use the group to make your cars faster.

name: Daytona 500
description: In Daytona 500, small plastic race cars drive around a big oval track. You bid money on the cars before the race and play cards to move them. The player whose cars finish first wins the most money.

name: Wacky Races: The Board Game
description: Wacky Races is a funny car race, from the old cartoon. Each player drives a crazy car with its own tricks. You drive to the finish line, and you can play dirty tricks to slow down the other cars.

name: PitchCar
description: In PitchCar, you flick small wooden discs, which are the race cars, around a track made of wooden pieces. You build the track from the box. It is easy to learn and fun for the whole family.

name: Formula Motor Racing
description: Formula Motor Racing is a game about Formula racing cars. You choose how fast to drive your car around the track and when to stop for new tires. The fastest and luckiest driver wins.

name: Carcassonne
description: In Carcassonne, you build a land from the Middle Ages, one tile at a time. You place roads, cities and farms, and put your followers on them to win points. It is easy to learn and good for families.

name: Munchkin
description: Munchkin is a funny card game about going into a dungeon, beating monsters and taking treasure. You can also play tricks on your friends and take their treasure. It makes fun of old role-playing games.

name: Catan
description: In Catan, you build roads and towns on an island. You trade wood, bricks and sheep with the other players to build more. The player with the most points wins.

name: Azul
description: In Azul, you pick colorful tiles and place them on your board to make a pretty wall, like in an old palace. You get points for nice patterns. The game is quiet and easy to learn.

name: Codenames
description: Codenames is a word game for two teams. One player gives a one-word clue to help the team find their agents among words on the table. Each team tries to find all of its agents first.

name: Splendor
description: In Splendor, you buy gems and use them to buy cards that give you more gems. You become a rich gem seller. The game is easy and quick.

name: Dixit
description: Dixit is a game with beautiful dream-like pictures. One player says a hint about a picture, and everybody picks a card that could match. The hint must be clear, but not too clear.

name: 7 Wonders
description: In 7 Wonders, each player builds a city of the old world and one great building, like a pyramid. You pick a card and pass the others to your neighbor. The best city gets the most points.

name: Dominion
description: Dominion is a card game where you build your own deck of cards. You buy new cards with the money you have. The player with the most land cards at the end wins.

name: Puerto Rico
description: In Puerto Rico, you are a farmer on an island. You grow crops, sell them and send them to Europe by ship. Each turn a player picks a job, and the others can use it too.

name: Hive
description: Hive is a game for two players with bug pieces. You move ants, beetles and spiders around the table to trap the queen bee of the other player. There is no board.

name: Sushi Go!
description: In Sushi Go!, you pick a card from your hand and pass the rest to your neighbor, like plates on a sushi belt. You collect sets of tasty dishes for points. The rules take two minutes to learn.

name: Love Letter
description: Love Letter is a tiny card game with only sixteen cards. You try to get your letter to the princess, and you try to guess what the other players hold. Each round is over in a few minutes.

name: Takenoko
description: In Takenoko, you take care of a garden for the emperor of Japan. A gardener grows the bamboo and a hungry panda eats it. You win by finishing your goals in the garden.

name: Bohnanza
description: Bohnanza is a funny card game about planting and selling beans. You may not change the order of the cards in your hand, so you must trade with the other players to get rid of the beans you do not want.

name: Cat Cafe Evenings
description: In Cat Cafe Evenings, you run a small cafe full of cats. You serve tea and cake to your guests and keep the cats happy. The more friendly cats you have, the more points you get.

name: Little Bakery
description: Little Bakery is a warm game about baking bread and cakes. You buy flour, sugar and eggs, bake in your oven and sell to the people of the village. The best baker at the end of the week wins.

name: Tea Garden
description: In Tea Garden, you grow tea on a green hill. You pick the leaves, dry them and sell the tea at the market. The game is quiet and you make your plan slowly.

name: Orchestra Night
description: Orchestra Night is a party game about music. Each player plays one instrument and the group tries to make a tune together. You pass cards, make sounds and laugh a lot.

name: Mountain Trail
description: Mountain Trail is a game about hiking in the Alps. You walk from hut to hut, keep your bag light and enjoy the view. Each day you pick a path and try to arrive before the sun goes down.

name: Campfire Tales
description: Campfire Tales is a storytelling game for friends. Each player gets a few picture cards and tells a short story that uses all of them. The group votes for the best story.

name: Butterfly Meadow
description: In Butterfly Meadow, you plant flowers and invite butterflies to your garden. Every butterfly likes different flowers, so you plan your garden with care. It is a quiet and colorful game.

name: Mini Golf Madness
description: Mini Golf Madness brings a golf course to your table. You flick a small ball over bridges, tunnels and windmills made of cardboard. The player with the fewest shots wins.

name: Bowling Night
description: Bowling Night is a light dice game about a night at the bowling alley. You roll dice to knock down the pins and try to score a strike. It is easy for kids and adults.

name: Riddle House
description: In Riddle House, you solve riddles in a friendly old house. Each room has a puzzle with a clue, and the team opens the next door when it finds the answer. No one gets hurt and everyone gets help.

name: Draw and Guess
description: In Draw and Guess, one player draws a picture and the team tries to guess the word. The drawings are often very bad, and that is half the fun. You need only a pencil and paper.

name: Charades Deluxe
description: Charades Deluxe is a party game where you act out words without speaking. Your team must guess before the sand runs out. It is loud and funny.

name: Flower Festival
description: Flower Festival is a bright game about a spring parade. You make flower wagons, pick the best colors and show them to the crowd. The prettiest parade wins the festival.

name: Coffee Roasters
description: In Coffee Roasters, you buy green beans from far away farms, roast them and sell fresh coffee in your shop. You must pick the right beans for your customers. The best coffee shop wins.

name: Dinosaur Island Park
description: Dinosaur Island Park is a friendly game about running a park with dinosaurs. You build pens, feed the animals and welcome families. The more happy guests you have, the more points you get.

name: Pirate Treasure Cove
description: In Pirate Treasure Cove, you sail a small ship in a sunny bay. You look for hidden gold, trade with island people and fill your chest. It is a light adventure for the whole family.

name: Hot Air Balloons
description: Hot Air Balloons is a gentle game about a trip over green hills. You go up and down to catch the right wind and land in a village. The wind can be hard to guess, but the view is nice.

name: Origami Garden
description: In Origami Garden, you fold paper animals and place them in a quiet garden. Each animal likes a different spot. You earn points for a garden in good balance.

name: Moonlit Lanterns
description: In Moonlit Lanterns, you hang paper lanterns over a quiet lake. You match colors to make bright rows and light the water for the guests. The game is peaceful and very pretty.

name: Apple Orchard
description: In Apple Orchard, you pick fruit from your trees before the basket of the other player is full. You roll a die to see which fruit you may take. Good for families with small children.

name: Seaside Ice Cream
description: Seaside Ice Cream is a summer game about an ice cream stand on the beach. You pick flavors, stack scoops and serve the people in the queue. Melting scoops lose you points.

name: Library of Stories
description: In Library of Stories, you build a cozy library with shelves and reading corners. You collect books by kind, and readers pay you for the right book at the right time. The best library wins.

name: Beekeeper's Honey
description: In Beekeeper's Honey, you look after hives on a green hill and collect honey in jars. You pick the right flowers for your bees and sell the honey in town. A sweet and calm game.

name: Kite Festival
description: Kite Festival is a light game about flying kites on a windy hill. You play cards to pick the wind and lift your kite as high as it can go. Tall kites win.

name: Puzzle Cafe
description: Puzzle Cafe is a tile game where you build a small cafe from pieces that fit together. You match tables, chairs and cups to please your guests. It is quiet and easy to learn.

name: Chocolate Factory
description: In Chocolate Factory, you run a small chocolate maker. You buy cocoa, make sweets and fill the boxes that the shops ask for. The most sweet and tidy factory wins.

name: Tiny Market Day
description: Tiny Market Day is a game about building a village market. You place stalls, carts and benches, and every neighbour makes your market better. It is a short and peaceful game.

name: Lunar Festival Dragons
description: In Lunar Festival Dragons, you dance with long paper dragons through a festival street. You play cards to make your dragon longer and brighter than the others. Great for a big family.

name: Hedgehog Hideaway
description: In Hedgehog Hideaway, you help little hedgehogs find a warm place for the winter. You collect leaves and apples and bring them to the nest. It is cute and good for children.

name: Chess Club Mini
description: Chess Club Mini is a small version of chess for two players on a four by four board. Each side has only a few pieces, so the game is over in minutes. It is a good way to learn how pieces move.
